std_narrative.citation:
Åse Østby was named in an engagement notice in Salten, published on 5 November 1952. The notice also named Ole Åsen in the engagement announcement. The notice reported the engagement before 3 May 1920 in Bergen. '''Engagement Notice''': "Salten. Fauske, 5 November 1952. Edition: 43-45-1"
